const r=await tools.image_gen__imagegen({prompt:"A new high-resolution 16:9 photorealistic photograph of the interior of an old empty Japanese local railway carriage at a rainy remote station at night. The train uses TRANSVERSE REVERSIBLE SEATS: short freestanding TWO-SEAT BENCHES oriented across the carriage, separated by aisle space, with silver pivot brackets and visible black rotation handgrips on their aisle ends. Camera is standing in the central longitudinal aisle at 1.4m eye height, looking diagonally forward LEFT toward TWO adjacent transverse teal moquette seat pairs and the left window wall. Closest seat pair occupies lower-left and lower-middle of the image, its entire freestanding seat base and aisle-side rotation bracket visible. A small worn dark brown leather doctor's bag sits on the closest seat, front facing camera. This bag has a rigid framed top mouth with a single brass flip clasp, leather carry handle, a loose long shoulder strap draped vertically over the flip clasp, and a small triangular repair patch low on the front left. A cream receipt sticks from beneath its handle. Silver overhead rack, hanging white straps, cream painted walls, dark grey linoleum floor with soft reflections. Farther right is an OPEN SLIDING PASSENGER DOOR facing a wet rural platform with a warm lamp. Beyond the left windows is a readable weathered station sign 「きさらぎ」. On the cream wall immediately beside the open door, a small plain closed dark metal document box with a rectangular brass lock plate and an inset horizontal dark window. An old cream ticket lies near the door on the floor. Moody real late-night available-light photography, muted teal/brown/cream, natural Japanese railway fittings, coherent perspective, subtle lens rendering, tactile wear, sharp readable real objects, deep space through the doorway. All objects photographically integrated with soft contact shadows. Edge-to-edge environment photograph." ,transparent_background:false});store("remakeTrainV2",r);generatedImage(r);
